get.summary: Executes a routing request between de From and To point, using the selected transportation option

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Starting point coordinates in format lat,lon (use "." character as decimal separator) or Stop-ID (ids used in routing data, can also come from autocomplete or near-by-search, e.g. `0013000` for Leipzig main station Tram/Bus).

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Ending point coordinates in format lat,lon, same format as the ``From`` parameter or Stop-ID (ids used in routing data, can also come from autocomplete or near-by-search, e.g. `0013000` for Leipzig main station Tram/Bus)

parameters.name: Travelmode
parameters.description:
Transportation type. Comma separated list of desired modes:
  • TRANSIT (the same as WALK,TRAM,BUS,SUBURB,TRAIN)
  • BIKE
  • BIKERENTAL
  • WALK
  • CAR
  • CARRENTAL
  • BUS
  • TRAM
  • SUBURB (suburban railway -> S-Bahn)
  • TRAIN (regional and long distance)
  • TAXI4884 (execeutes a CAR Routing search. Only a trip is returned if the start-coordinate is within the TAXI4884 service area)
  • ESCOOTER (Executes an Escooter search, with maximun 15 minutes walking legs)
  • FLEXA (Search for possible on-demand bus Flexa in Leipzig)
  • SUBWAY U-Bahn
  • RRB rail replacement bus (SEV)
  • OD on-demand-bus (Rufbus)
  • ICE inter-city-express
  • IC inter-city rail
  • COACH long distance bus
  • RE regional express (Regional-Bahn)

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Departure time, in format hh:mm(am or pm) To set this parameter, the date parameter has to be specified

parameters.name: arriveBy
parameters.description: If set to true, the given date and time refer to arrival time

parameters.name: accessibility
parameters.description: If set to 1, then only wheelchair enabled routes are returned

parameters.name: shortWalk
parameters.description: If set to 1, then short walks would be prefered by the algorithm

parameters.name: lessTransfers
parameters.description: If set to 1, then less transportation transfers would be prefered by algorithm

parameters.name: maxWalkDistance
parameters.description: Maximum walking distance to a station in meters, default 5000

parameters.name: mockup
parameters.description: Indicates if mockup alternative-routes are required
